open_text_result: A reusable Greek Sententiae text is available through First1K/Scaife under the exact CTS work identifier; it begins with Mon 1 M/1 J. It is an open corpus transcription, not a claim that the entire Jäkel 1964 critical apparatus or every codex reading is free.
